title: Twice in Six Days: What Andhra Pradesh's Twin Cyclones Say About Clustered Storm Risk
detail: Cyclones Arnab and Murasu hit the same Indian coast six days apart, a year to the day after Montha, leaving ₹11,784 crore of first loss estimates; our engine's storm record contains none of the three.
author: Shrinivash D Kannan
